name: Authors Posts Widget
author: Fahad Mahmood

sections.description:
Authors Posts Widget lists your authors and their latest posts in a tidy, collapsible list that works in sidebars, footers, pages and posts. Visitors open an author to see what they have written, with no page reload.

Version 2 is a full rebuild for modern WordPress: a Gutenberg block, a shortcode, the classic widget, faster queries, caching, better accessibility and tighter security.

Features

  • Three ways to use it: block, widget (classic and block widget areas) and the [authors_posts] shortcode.
  • Collapsible authors built on native HTML <details>: keyboard friendly, screen-reader friendly and works even when JavaScript is blocked.
  • Control what is shown: posts per author, excerpts (with length), avatars, post counts, post dates, “View all posts” archive link, expand the first author by default.
  • Order and filter: order authors by name or by number of posts, exclude authors by ID.
  • Fast: one small set of queries per list, cached automatically and refreshed when posts or users change. Styles load only on pages that show a list.
  • Looks right in your theme: colors inherit from the theme (light, dark, block themes), RTL ready, optional link color.
  • Secure by default: every input is validated, every output escaped, password-protected excerpts are never shown and only public display names are used.
  • Translation ready.

Shortcode

[authors_posts number="3" display_excerpt="true" orderby="post_count" order="DESC"]

Attributes: number, orderby (name, post_count), order (ASC, DESC), exclude, max_authors, display_excerpt, excerpt_length, show_avatar, avatar_size, show_count, show_date, link_author, open_first.

Developers

The list is built from clean filters and actions (for example apw_default_args, apw_query_args, apw_users_args, apw_author_data, apw_post_data, apw_cache_ttl, apw_max_posts_per_author). Cached lists can be cleared from Settings > Authors Posts Widget.

Pro

A Pro add-on is available with accordion and card layouts, live author search, post thumbnails, author bios, post type and category filters, role filters and a “Load more” button. See Settings > Authors Posts Widget > Pro for details.
sections.installation:
1. In your admin go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Authors Posts Widget” and click Install Now, then Activate.
  2. Add it where you want it:
    • Block editor: insert the Authors Posts block.
    • Widgets: Appearance > Widgets, add Authors Posts to a sidebar.
    • Anywhere: use the [authors_posts] shortcode.
  3. Optional: Settings > Authors Posts Widget for the link color, stylesheet and cache options.
sections.faq:
Does it work with block themes and the block widget editor?

Yes. Use the Authors Posts block, or the legacy widget block, which keeps working with widgets you configured before.

I already use the old widget. Will it still work?

Yes. The widget ID and your saved settings are unchanged. New options simply use sensible defaults.

Why do I not see an author?

Only authors with at least one published post are listed. Check the “exclude” setting too.

The list looks different after updating.

Version 2 inherits your theme colors and uses a lighter layout. Custom CSS that targets #apw-authors, .apw-parent or .apw-posts still matches. If you want the old look back, add your own CSS or turn off the plugin stylesheet in the settings.

Can I change how long lists are cached?

Yes: add_filter( 'apw_cache_ttl', function () { return HOUR_IN_SECONDS; } ); Return 0 to disable caching.

Why is the number of posts capped at 100 per author?

To protect your database on very large sites. Developers can change it with the apw_max_posts_per_author filter.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • New: Authors Posts block (server rendered, no build step).
  • New: [authors_posts] shortcode.
  • New: options for post counts, avatars, dates, excerpt length, ordering, excluding authors, author archive link and expanding the first author.
  • New: settings page with link color, stylesheet toggle and cache tools.
  • New: caching with automatic refresh when posts or users change.
  • New: optional Pro add-on support (plug-and-play “pro” folder).
  • Improved: accessibility. Authors are now native collapsible sections (keyboard and screen-reader friendly, work without JavaScript).
  • Improved: performance. Fewer queries, assets loaded only when needed, jQuery no longer required.
  • Improved: the post count now shows the author’s real number of posts, not just the number displayed.
  • Improved: excerpts fall back to the beginning of the post when no manual excerpt exists.
  • Security: all inputs validated and outputs escaped, public display names used instead of first and last names, no excerpts for password-protected posts, hard limits on authors and posts per list, hardened uninstall routine, no raw SQL.
  • Compatibility: tested with WordPress 7.1, requires WordPress 6.0 and PHP 7.4.
  • Removed: legacy jQuery script and image icons (replaced by CSS).

1.4.2

  • Reorganized and formatted CSS with clearer sectioning and consistent indentation. [25/10/2025]

1.4.0

  • Version updated for WordPress. [05/06/2024]
